sources.quote: Completion: every task is checked, or the only unchecked ones carry their one-line reason.
Then open the verify stage document (`/opsx/stages/03-verify.md`) and continue
Always read context files before starting (from the apply instructions output)
Before the first step that writes anything (`new change`, `archive`, `sync specs`, or authoring an artifact file), confirm the project has a root: run `openspec list --json`
do not run `openspec init` until the user asks for it

unitemized.reason: Applies only when a task is unclear; no observable predicate tells when a task was unclear, so the condition can't be expressed.
Applies only when a task needs work beyond the spec; that condition can't be observed or expressed as a predicate.
Already covered by the ap-067 openspec_ff.tasks done_or_reasoned item (unchecked task with a one-line reason).
Repeats line 105 (ap-066); covered by the ap-067 done_or_reasoned item.
The status display ('N/M tasks complete') is chat output, not an artifact or command. No kind checks it.
'Runtime context or operation guidance' has no fixed text in the document to match against, so no residue pattern can be written without inventing one.
Applies only when `openspec list --json` exits non-zero with root null, which can't be expressed as a predicate. No kind checks 'no retry' of list.
Applies only when a store-declaration error occurs, which can't be expressed. Showing the message to the user isn't checkable by any kind.
Applies only to the no-root, auto-selected branch, which can't be expressed. A prohibition on what the reply mentions isn't checkable.
Applies only to the no-root, explicit-request branch, which can't be expressed. Asking the user how to proceed isn't checkable.
The sandbox already provides the openspec/ root, so it can't be created as a side effect. The one checkable part (no `openspec init`) is covered by vf-011.
